scope: reviewed habka dhimman marker + verb pairs
description: Check exact source-backed dependent subject markers together with their reviewed verb forms, including affirmative uu/ay/... forms and negative uusan/aysan/ayan + cunin forms.
evidence: Qaamuuska Af-Soomaaliga (Puglielli & Mansuur, 2012), Shaxannada CUN, p. 922, habka dhimman
notes: Dependent markers are not ordinary main-clause wuu/way clitics.
Negative cunin neutralizes verb person, while the dependent marker still identifies the cited person set.
Only exact reviewed marker+verb pairs are judged; unknown verbs are not generated or guessed.
